blocks.text: South Korean police are investigating a brawl that is believed to have involved some 10 foreign nationals at a park in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, late Saturday night, authorities said Monday. The Pyeongtaek Police Station said it received a report at around 11:30 p.m. Saturday that “a group of foreigners were engaged in a brawl.” Video footage taken by a nearby member of Korea Citizens on Patrol, a neighborhood watch group voluntarily organized by local residents, shows several people surrounding a crouching man, kicking him and striking him with clubs.
